+"""Safe image loading utilities with SSRF protection."""
+
+import base64
+import io
+import ipaddress
+import socket
+from typing import Optional
+from urllib.parse import urlparse
+
+import requests
+from PIL import Image
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.core.logging import get_logger
+from app.services.storage import storage
+
+logger = get_logger(__name__)
+
+_BLOCKED_HOSTNAMES = {"localhost", "localhost.localdomain"}
+_BLOCKED_SUFFIXES = (".localhost", ".local", ".internal")
+_CGNAT_NET = ipaddress.ip_network("100.64.0.0/10")
+_THIS_NET = ipaddress.ip_network("0.0.0.0/8")
+
+
+def _is_public_ip(ip_str: str) -> bool:
+    """Return True only if ip_str is a globally routable public IP address."""
+    ip_clean = ip_str.split("%", 1)[0]
+    try:
+        ip = ipaddress.ip_address(ip_clean)
+    except ValueError:
+        return False
+
+    if isinstance(ip, ipaddress.IPv6Address) and ip.ipv4_mapped:
+        ip = ip.ipv4_mapped
+
+    if (
+        ip.is_private
+        or ip.is_loopback
+        or ip.is_link_local
+        or ip.is_multicast
+        or ip.is_reserved
+        or ip.is_unspecified
+        or not ip.is_global
+    ):
+        return False
+
+    if isinstance(ip, ipaddress.IPv4Address):
+        if ip in _CGNAT_NET or ip in _THIS_NET:
+            return False
+
+    return True
+
+
+def is_safe_external_url(url: str) -> bool:
+    """Return True if url is an http/https URL resolving exclusively to public IPs."""
+    try:
+        parsed = urlparse(url)
+    except Exception:
+        return False
+
+    if parsed.scheme not in ("http", "https") or not parsed.hostname:
+        return False
+
+    hostname = parsed.hostname.lower().rstrip(".")
+    if not hostname or hostname in _BLOCKED_HOSTNAMES or hostname.endswith(_BLOCKED_SUFFIXES):
+        return False
+
+    try:
+        port = parsed.port or (443 if parsed.scheme == "https" else 80)
+    except ValueError:
+        return False
+
+    try:
+        addrinfo = socket.getaddrinfo(hostname, port, type=socket.SOCK_STREAM)
+    except socket.gaierror:
+        return False
+
+    if not addrinfo:
+        return False
+
+    for entry in addrinfo:
+        sockaddr = entry[4]
+        if not sockaddr:
+            return False
+        if not _is_public_ip(sockaddr[0]):
+            return False
+
+    return True
+
+
+def _extract_storage_relative_path(url: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """If url points to configured STORAGE_HOST, return its relative object path."""
+    storage_host = (settings.STORAGE_HOST or "").rstrip("/")
+    if not storage_host or not url.startswith(f"{storage_host}/"):
+        return None
+
+    parsed = urlparse(url)
+    storage_parsed = urlparse(storage_host)
+    if parsed.scheme != storage_parsed.scheme or parsed.netloc != storage_parsed.netloc:
+        return None
+
+    prefix = storage_parsed.path.rstrip("/") + "/"
+    if not parsed.path.startswith(prefix):
+        return None
+
+    relative_path = parsed.path[len(prefix):]
+    if not relative_path or ".." in relative_path.split("/"):
+        return None
+
+    return relative_path
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(url: str, timeout: int = 30) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """
+    Safely load image bytes from a data:image URL, a storage path/URL,
+    or a validated public HTTP/HTTPS URL. Never requests private/internal addresses.
+    """
+    if not url or not isinstance(url, str):
+        return None
+
+    url = url.strip()
+    if not url:
+        return None
+
+    try:
+        if url.startswith("data:"):
+            if not url.startswith("data:image"):
+                logger.warning("Blocked non-image data URL")
+                return None
+            if "," not in url:
+                return None
+            _, encoded = url.split(",", 1)
+            return base64.b64decode(encoded)
+
+        storage_rel = _extract_storage_relative_path(url)
+        if storage_rel is not None:
+            return storage.download_image(storage_rel)
+
+        if not url.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
+            if url.startswith("//") or url.startswith("/") or "://" in url or ".." in url.split("/"):
+                logger.warning("Blocked unsafe relative/non-http image path")
+                return None
+            return storage.download_image(url)
+
+        if not is_safe_external_url(url):
+            logger.warning("Blocked unsafe image URL", url=url[:100])
+            return None
+
+        resp = requests.get(url, timeout=timeout, allow_redirects=False)
+        if resp.status_code == 200:
+            return resp.content
+        logger.warning("Failed to fetch image", status_code=resp.status_code)
+        return None
+    except Exception as e:
+        logger.warning("Failed to load image", error=str(e))
+        return None
+
+
+def load_image_pil(
+    url: str,
+    timeout: int = 30,
+    mode: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> Optional[Image.Image]:
+    """Safely load an image as a PIL Image."""
+    img_bytes = load_image_bytes(url, timeout=timeout)
+    if not img_bytes:
+        return None
+    try:
+        img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_bytes))
+        if mode:
+            img = img.convert(mode)
+        return img
+    except Exception as e:
+        logger.warning("Failed to decode image", error=str(e))
+        return None

+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+from app.services.storage import storage
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG
+
+
+def _create_episode(client, headers):
+    project_res = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": "Missing Cuts Test", "genres": []})
+    assert project_res.status_code == 200, project_res.text
+    project_id = project_res.json()["id"]
+
+    episode_res = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"project_id": project_id, "episode_order": 1, "title": "Ep 1"},
+    )
+    assert episode_res.status_code == 200, episode_res.text
+    return episode_res.json()["id"]
+
+
+def _add_cut(client, headers, episode_id, cut_order, image_path=None):
+    res = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": episode_id,
+            "cut_order": cut_order,
+            "script": f"Cut {cut_order}",
+            "image_path": image_path,
+        },
+    )
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    return res.json()["id"]
+
+
+def test_export_with_no_missing_cuts_has_no_missing_txt_or_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _create_episode(client, h)
+    data_url = f"data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(PNG).decode('ascii')}"
+    rel_path = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier="ok")
+
+    _add_cut(client, h, episode_id, 1, data_url)
+    _add_cut(client, h, episode_id, 2, rel_path)
+
+    zip_res = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+    assert zip_res.status_code == 200, zip_res.text
+    assert "x-missing-cuts" not in {k.lower() for k in zip_res.headers.keys()}
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(zip_res.content), "r") as zf:
+        assert "missing.txt" not in zf.namelist()
+        assert len(zf.namelist()) == 2
+
+    strip_res = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export", headers=h)
+    assert strip_res.status_code == 200, strip_res.text
+    assert "x-missing-cuts" not in {k.lower() for k in strip_res.headers.keys()}
+
+
+def test_export_reports_missing_cuts_in_zip_and_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _create_episode(client, h)
+    data_url = f"data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(PNG).decode('ascii')}"
+    rel_path = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier="ok2")

+    _add_cut(client, h, episode_id, 1, data_url)  # valid

+class _RecordingHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+    received_paths: list[str] = []
+
+    def do_GET(self):
+        self.__class__.received_paths.append(self.path)
+        self.send_response(200)

+
+
+def _start_local_server():

+def test_url_safety_blocks_private_metadata_and_unsafe_schemes():
+    unsafe_urls = [
+        "http://127.0.0.1/secret",
+        "http://10.0.0.1/secret",
+        "http://172.16.0.1/secret",
+        "http://192.168.1.1/secret",
+        "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/",
+        "http://100.64.0.1/secret",
+        "http://0.0.0.0/secret",
+        "http://[::1]/secret",
+        "http://[::ffff:127.0.0.1]/secret",
+        "http://[fc00::1]/secret",
+        "http://[fe80::1]/secret",
+        "http://localhost/secret",
+        "http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/",
+    ]
+    for url in unsafe_urls:
+        assert not is_safe_external_url(url), f"Expected blocked: {url}"
+        assert load_image_bytes(url) is None, f"Expected None: {url}"
+
+    for non_http in (
+        "file:///etc/passwd",
+        "ftp://example.com/img.png",
+        "gopher://127.0.0.1:6379/_INFO",
+        "//127.0.0.1/secret",
+        "../etc/passwd",
+        "data:text/plain;base64,SGVsbG8=",
+    ):
+        assert load_image_bytes(non_http) is None, f"Expected None: {non_http}"
+
+    assert is_safe_external_url("https://93.184.216.34/image.png")
